name: Ibrány (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Ibrány: a blue shield with a sheaf of grain and a bird, with a helm, a stag crest and red, blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed IBRÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Ibrány arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
